messages:
andre: nightly-eval found 2 failures for redwood-7b-q4 in the tool-calling prompt set. looks like generated JSON has wrong types for some fields, e.g. duration_ms is "N/A" instead of an int. failing tests: 241, 242.

maya: can you paste the raw generation + the expected schema?

andre: pasted below (raw from eval harness). note the model was the quantized build from yesterday's CI.

dev-eval-bot: nightly-eval run 2026-03-22T02:00Z: 2 regressions (regression_id=ev-241-242). artifacts: s3://redwood-nightly/runs/2026-03-22/1779654321.tar.gz

andre: ```
EXPECTED_SCHEMA = {
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "extract_metrics",
    "args": {
      "duration_ms": "int",
      "success": "bool",
      "extras": "object?"
    }
  }
}

RAW_GENERATION = {
  "tool_call": {
    "name": "extract_metrics",
    "args": "{\"duration_ms\": \"N/A\", \"success\": \"true\"}"
  }
}
```

sophia: ugh, so the model returned args as a single escaped string instead of a JSON object. that will break our function-invoker.

liam: repro notes: ran local quantized artifact (q4f) and sent the same prompt; saw identical behavior. non-quantized model returns proper object. suspect quantization-induced tokenization boundary that inserts quotes? :face_with_monocle:

andre: interesting. stack trace from our invoker: ```
TypeError: args must be object, got string
 at parseToolCall (/srv/invoker/index.js:142)
 at handleResponse (/srv/invoker/index.js:89)
```

maya: immediate mitigation: invoker should try JSON.parse when args is a string and validate types; will open a hotfix. but we should also root-cause in model output.

andre: I've started a small eval sweep comparing tokenization on quant vs fp16. early diff: quantized model sometimes emits an extra \u00A0 (NBSP) between braces and quotes which ends up escaped inside the generation, e.g. `"{\u00A0\"duration_ms\"...}`. that would make our heuristics treat it as a string.

liam: can you add the exact token ids around that region?

andre: yes, attached token ids in the artifact. quick snippet: ```
... 1542  11  34512  10294  2  ...
 tokens -> "{ \u00A0 \"duration_ms\" ..."
```

maya: I'm pushing a small invoker patch that does: if typeof args === 'string' then try JSON.parse(args.replace(/\u00A0/g,' ')) with tests. will post PR link in a bit.

andre: thanks. parallel investigation: Sophia/R&D, can you check quant kernel handling for bytes that map to NBSP? maybe an off-by-one in dequant rounding producing 0xC2 0xA0 sequence?

sophia: on it. I'll run a diff on the token -> byte mapping and confirm if quantization changes the output bytes around punctuation.

liam: also worth validating our eval harness: it currently compares types strictly. maybe allow a tolerant mode to classify string-encoded-JSON as a soft-failure vs hard-failure so we don't noisy-alert on invoker-mitigable issues.

andre: agreed. for tracking: ev-241 = args-as-string, ev-242 = duration_ms string instead of int when parsed (because it was "N/A"). created ticket ML-562 with logs and repro steps. assigning to sophia + maya.

maya: hotfix PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/invoker/pull/983 - adds safe-parse and NBSP normalization + unit tests.

andre: repro checklist for R&D: 1) run prompt set on q4 artifact from 2026-03-21 2) dump raw tokens and bytes 3) compare with fp16 run 4) try small re-run with slight temperature change to see if deterministic.

dev-eval-bot: rerun scheduled: 2026-03-22T03:30Z with hotfix in invoker branch (test-only). will report results.

sophia: preliminary finding: q4 dequant rounding produced 0xC2 0xA0 sequence 12/1000 prompts near braces. looks correlated with a specific kernel path. filing infra bug with perf team.

liam: good catch. after hotfix we should re-run nightly and demote to soft-fail if invoker can auto-correct.

andre: thanks team. leaving this thread as the main triage log. will paste final postmortem once we confirm fix and green rerun. :thumbsup:
